projects.name: OpenViking Expand for DSH
projects.description: Bring OpenViking Studio and a browsable viking:// sidebar into DeepSeek Harness. Preview files and L0/L1 summaries, then reference a URI in the current chat without leaving DSH.
projects.descriptionZh: 把 OpenViking Studio 和 viking:// 文件树带进 DeepSeek Harness。可预览文件与 L0/L1 摘要，并将 URI 直接引用到当前会话。

projects.name: OpenViking for Antigravity CLI
projects.description: Recall context, capture conversation turns, and browse viking:// memories, skills, and rules in Google Antigravity CLI (agy). Bridges agy lifecycle hooks, subagents, skills, and stdio MCP to OpenViking REST and Streamable HTTP APIs via a single Rust binary.
projects.descriptionZh: 在 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）中自动召回上下文、沉淀对话轮次并浏览 viking:// 记忆、技能与规则。通过单一 Rust 二进制将 agy 钩子、子智能体、技能与 MCP 桥接至 OpenViking。

projects.name: DeerFlow
projects.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness for research, coding, and content creation, combining sandboxes, memory, tools, skills, and subagents.
projects.descriptionZh: 开源的长任务 SuperAgent 框架，将沙箱、记忆、工具、技能与子智能体组合起来，完成研究、编程和内容创作。

projects.name: NoKV
projects.description: An AI-native distributed filesystem that gives agents a shared workspace for durable files and collaborative context.
projects.descriptionZh: 面向 AI 的分布式文件系统，为智能体提供可持久保存文件、共享上下文的协作工作区。

projects.name: loopx
projects.description: A local-first semantic control plane and research workbench that turns long-horizon goals into verifiable results across sessions and agent runtimes.
projects.descriptionZh: 本地优先的语义控制平面与研究工作台，跨会话、跨智能体运行时，把长期目标转化为可验证的结果。

projects.name: Hermes Agent
projects.description: A self-improving agent with native OpenViking memory support for persistent recall, capture, and cross-session continuity.
projects.descriptionZh: 可持续成长的智能体，原生支持 OpenViking 记忆，让召回、沉淀与跨会话连续性开箱即用。

projects.name: NVIDIA cuVS
projects.description: GPU-accelerated vector search and clustering primitives for building fast, scalable retrieval systems.
projects.descriptionZh: GPU 加速的向量检索与聚类基础库，为高速、可扩展的检索系统提供底层能力。
